description: This file implements a text-to-speech (TTS) service using the Coqui XTTS streaming server. It provides a class `XTTSService` for integrating with the server, including methods for starting the service, converting language codes, and streaming synthesized speech frames asynchronously.

classes.name: XTTSService
classes.description: A service class that interfaces with the Coqui XTTS streaming server for text-to-speech synthesis, supporting multiple languages, voice IDs, and streaming audio data.

methods.name: Optional[str] language_to_xtts_language(language: Language)
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to the corresponding XTTS language code string, based on a predefined mapping.

methods.name: XTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the XTTSService with voice ID, server URL, HTTP session, language, sample rate, and additional kwargs.

methods.name: XTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation (returns True).

methods.name: XTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum into a format suitable for the XTTS service.

methods.name: XTTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the service, retrieves studio speakers list from the server if not already loaded.

methods.name: XTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronously streams synthesized speech frames for the given text, handling HTTP communication with the XTTS server, resampling, and streaming frames.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, voice_id: str, base_url: str, aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, language: Language = Language.EN, sample_rate: Optional[int] = None, **kwargs, )

ctags.signature: ( self, *, voice_id: str, base_url: str, aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, language: Language = Language.EN, sample_rate: Optional[int] = None, **kwargs, )
